question: What is the maximum central subsidy cap under PM Surya Ghar?
generated_answer:
Under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, the maximum central subsidy (Central Financial Assistance / CFA) for individual residential systems is strictly capped at **₹78,000**. 

This maximum cap applies to any residential system of 3 kW capacity or larger (e.g., 3 kW, 4 kW, 5 kW, 10 kW systems all receive the capped maximum subsidy of ₹78,000).
